notes: Random combat result tables (0..8 records of 54 bytes at 0x1d0000, the count sometimes -1) with outcomes 0..5, target categories 0..4 and out of range, shooter categories 0..3/7, weapons including 0x1b and 0x21..0x24, and target/shooter units that are absent (-1), keyed in the unit list or unknown (falling back to the mission's group); group, unit and static lists of 0..5 nodes. Categories that leave a name untouched are only used after a written record, so both buffers start initialised. The 0xbc400 stub logs the stream, format and three arguments, or for the name line the two strings themselves; copy_string and the list lookups run as originals.
